css_analysis_note:
Why new characters may not appear in-game:

1. This file defines exactly {face_count} FaceIcon collision boxes for the character select screen. The game only renders character icons where collision boxes exist.

2. Adding a character in characode.bin gives them an ID/slot, but without a corresponding FaceIcon collision here, there is no clickable area on the CSS.

3. The game .exe likely has a hardcoded max roster size that matches the collision count. Even if you add a FaceIcon here, the .exe may ignore entries beyond its internal limit.

4. To add a new character slot:
   a) Add a FaceIcon collision with correct position
   b) Update the _array num= count for this set
   c) The .exe roster limit may also need patching

ui_arcaderewardparam_reserved_hint: Retail file keeps this field at 0. It is still editable and preserved.
ui_arcaderewardparam_notes_hex_hint: Optional raw bytes between the header and entry table. Leave empty for retail Battle Rewards files.
ui_arcaderewardparam_invalid_integer: "{value}" is not valid for this field. Expected {min} to {max}.
ui_arcaderewardparam_invalid_hex: Notes bytes must be valid hexadecimal text.
ui_arcaderewardparam_cumulative_group_hi: Raw u32 reward group/track value from CumulativeRewardParam.
ui_arcaderewardparam_cumulative_threshol: Raw u32 cumulative requirement or milestone value.
ui_arcaderewardparam_cumulative_type_hin: Raw u32 reward type. Retail examples include card/title/art type values.
dlg_duel_setting: Edit battle mission settings, localization keys, SCM condition ids, optional target names, and raw numeric values from DuelSettingParam.bin.xfbin.
ui_duelsettingparam_file_filter: DuelSettingParam XFBIN files (DuelSettingParam.bin.xfbin DuelSettingsParam.bin.xfbin);;XFBIN files (*.xfbin);;All files (*.*)
ui_duelsettingparam_type_hint: Retail uses 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The file does not name these types; check what each type changes in-game.
ui_duelsettingparam_sequence_hint: Usually follows the battle mission numbering. Retail also uses 4294967295 on the first row.
ui_duelsettingparam_value_hint: Only the float layout is confirmed. Value 1 often looks like a threshold, time, or rate; Value 2 is non-zero only on a few retail rows.
ui_duelsettingparam_text_keys_hint: These strings are text keys already stored in the file: normal mission text, hidden text, and hint text.
ui_duelsettingparam_condition_hint: Optional strings from the file. SCM ids look like condition checks; target names are comma-separated internal names on a few rows.
ui_duelsettingparam_reserved_hint: Both reserved fields are 0 in the sample, but they are editable and preserved.
ui_duelsettingparam_invalid_integer: "{value}" is not valid for this field. Expected {min} to {max}.
ui_duelsettingparam_invalid_hex: Notes bytes must be valid hexadecimal text.
dlg_support_item: Edit SupportItemParam story/campaign support items: text keys, prices, tiers, effect values, and raw fields.
ui_supportitemparam_file_filter: SupportItemParam XFBIN files (SupportItemParam.bin.xfbin SupportItemParam.xfbin);;XFBIN files (*.xfbin);;All files (*.*)
ui_supportitemparam_support_id_hint: Sequential internal id from the entry table. Retail ids run 0-127 with gaps.
ui_supportitemparam_price_hint: Retail values look like shop or unlock costs. 99999 appears on unavailable or special entries; verify in-game.
ui_supportitemparam_tier_hint: Retail values include 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 99. The file does not name the categories.
ui_supportitemparam_text_hint: ASCII text key stored in the file string pool. Empty fields are saved as null pointers.
ui_supportitemparam_effect_type_hint: Retail values repeat like effect identifiers. Exact behavior needs in-game testing per value.
ui_supportitemparam_effect_value_hint: Looks like magnitude, rate, duration, or amount depending on effect type. Test changed values in-game.
ui_supportitemparam_target_group_hint: Retail values are 1 and 2 for active effect rows; likely selects who or what the effect applies to.
ui_supportitemparam_notes_hint: Optional raw bytes between the header and entry table. Retail SupportItemParam has none.
ui_supportitemparam_display_order_hint: For named retail rows this usually matches the visible support item ordering.
ui_supportitemparam_shop_marker_hint: Retail named support items use 99; battle-only rows and empty slots use 0.
ui_supportitemparam_unlock_or_story_flag: Retail uses 1 on several special/story rows. Exact behavior needs in-game testing.
ui_supportitemparam_raw_hint: Structurally confirmed raw field. The file does not name its meaning.
ui_supportitemparam_pre_text_blob_hint: Opaque bytes pointed to before the text keys. Preserved byte-for-byte; likely an internal hash/id block.
ui_supportitemparam_invalid_integer: "{value}" is not valid for this field. Expected {min} to {max}.
ui_supportitemparam_invalid_hex: Notes bytes must be valid hexadecimal text.
ui_supportitemparam_invalid_blob_hex: Pre-text blob must be valid hexadecimal text.
dlg_tutorial_param: Edit tutorial pages, text keys, linked UI assets, and raw layout values from TutorialParam.
ui_tutorialparam_file_filter: TutorialParam XFBIN files (TutorialParam.bin.xfbin TutorialParam.xfbin);;XFBIN files (*.xfbin);;All files (*.*)
ui_tutorialparam_category_hint: Top-level tutorial category string from the file, for example CUSTOMIZE, GALLERY, MODESELECT, or OPTION. Many child rows leave it empty.
ui_tutorialparam_entry_type_hint: Observed values are 0, 1, and 2. In the sample they look like page/container, body line, and title/subtitle rows; verify exact behavior in-game.
ui_tutorialparam_text_key_hint: ASCII key stored in the string pool. For text rows this usually points to tutorial_### localization text; for page rows it points to the tutorial node name.
ui_tutorialparam_asset_path_hint: Optional linked UI or language XFBIN path from the file. Empty fields are saved as null pointers.
ui_tutorialparam_dummy_key_hint: Secondary ASCII key from the file, often prefixed with dmy_. Exact fallback behavior should be tested in-game.
ui_tutorialparam_raw_28_hint: Observed values include 0, 1, 3, and 4. It appears to mark first/title/body roles, but the file does not name it.
ui_tutorialparam_raw_2c_hint: Observed values include 0, 1, 2, 4, and 5. It often changes with the visible tutorial line group or slot.
ui_tutorialparam_raw_30_hint: Observed values are 0 and 1. It usually pairs with Raw 0x48.
ui_tutorialparam_font_hint: Retail values are often 24 or 25 on text rows. This may affect text size or line height; verify in-game.
ui_tutorialparam_position_hint: Retail values include -1, 300, 440, 550, 910, 1100, and small offsets. This likely affects positioning or timing; verify in-game.
ui_tutorialparam_raw_44_hint: Observed values include 0, 1, 2, 4, and 5 and often mirror Raw 0x2C on body rows.
ui_tutorialparam_raw_48_hint: Observed values are 0 and 1 and often mirror Raw 0x30.
ui_tutorialparam_reserved_hint: Retail TutorialParam keeps this field at 0.
ui_tutorialparam_raw_hint: Structurally confirmed raw field. The file does not name its meaning.
ui_tutorialparam_notes_hint: Optional raw bytes between the header and entry table. Retail TutorialParam has none.
ui_tutorialparam_invalid_integer: "{value}" is not valid for this field. Expected {min} to {max}.
ui_tutorialparam_invalid_hex: Notes bytes must be valid hexadecimal text.
